source_metadata.title: Heparin: Mechanism of Action, Pharmacokinetics, Dosing Considerations, Monitoring, Efficacy, and Safety
source_metadata.source_scope_note: Secondary source. Trial results are represented as the chapter's report of underlying studies and tagged secondary_reported_result; this extraction does not imply that this chapter generated those primary data.

duplicate_review.note: No exact canonical-statement duplicates detected; overlapping source concepts were retained when independently reviewable.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is oriented to primary literature and has no dedicated atom kind for narrative-review recommendations or secondary-reported trial results. This run therefore uses existing kinds plus secondary_source and secondary_reported_result tags, while preserving provenance to the review chapter.
extraction_limitations: The chapter is a 1995 narrative review/consensus-conference chapter rather than a primary study.
Pure bibliography pages were not atomized.
Review-level evidence grades and appraisal statements were not converted into primary-study data.
Some historical trial details are summarized only to the level presented in the chapter; missing primary-study context was not invented.
